ambient_chatter.text: Has anyone seen my sacred chicken?? Last seen near the docks looking very holy and very unbothered :)
The rain in {town} is basically a personal attack on my boots xD
Lag again?! I'm convinced the server is plotting against me personally. Noted, server. I see you :/
Reminder: {village} still owes me one (1) goose. I am not angry. I am just counting :)
Bridge update: it still exists. I still hate it. We are not speaking until it apologizes xD

ambient_brag.text: My army of {troop_count} men marched into {fief} and the gate just politely opened. Respect is earned, friends :)
Treasury check: {gold} gold, zero regrets, one suspicious goose. Sound economics xD
{fief} is officially under new management. Management being me. Paperwork to follow, probably :D
Tallied the loot: {gold} gold and a cursed hat. The hat is already in my will. Long live the hat!!
Only {troop_count} soldiers and I still made {fief} weep. Tears of joy, obviously :)

beat_by_player.text: {player} out-fought my {troop_count} men at the ford. I am writing a strongly worded letter to the river :(
Ser {player}, you won fair and square, which is rude of you. Rematch in the mud, bring snacks :)
Ha! Your {troop_count} lads beat mine?! Enjoy it, {player}, the siege engine is only resting :D
Lost to {player} again. I have named the mud after them. Enjoy your victory, {player}, it will be sung about. Badly. xD
{player} won this round with {troop_count} men. The Duke accepts defeat with grace, mostly. Vengeance is a dish :)

beat_player.text: Glory to the ford! {player} lost with {troop_count} men, and I am keeping {gold} gold as a sign of respect :D
Ser {player}, that fight was glorious and you lost it beautifully. The {gold} gold is for your dignity. Drinks on me :)
{player}! Your {troop_count} men were very brave and very wet. Now kneel for the Duke's ceremonial mud bath xD
{player} fell at the crossing with {troop_count} men. Took {gold} gold. Your banners look better on my wall, ser :)
Nice try, {player}. {troop_count} men and still wet in the ditch. Want a rematch or a sandwich? :D

player_fled_from_me.text: {player} saw my banner and ran like a goose with a sword. Brave, brave soul. Tell your horses I said hi xD
Running away already, {player}? Wise. I would run too if I looked this fierce :)
Ser {player}, your retreat was very dignified. Very fast, too. Next time stop for a chat, I have snacks :D
{player} fled the field like a sheep that spotted a wolf. Sheep, I am proud of you for surviving. Mostly :)

player_win_streak.text: {player} is on a winning streak and the whole server is sulking. I am building a shrine out of their rejected banners :/
Five wins in a row, {player}? Impressive. Suspicious. Impressive. I am plotting a comeback in dramatic fashion :D
{player} won again. Somebody get them a chair, a crown, and a slightly less shiny sword. We are proud, sort of :)
Your streak ends at the bridge, {player}. The bridge is my ally now. Not sure it knows yet :D

peace_made.text: Peace with {faction}?! My heart is breaking and my wine cup is full. Shake hands now, slap them later :)
{my_faction} signs peace with {faction}. The Duke approved this under protest and a bowl of stew xD
Peace between {my_faction} and {faction}! Quick, somebody hide the catapults before they get ideas :D
{faction} and {my_faction} are friends now?? Bold. The mud still remembers the war, I think :/

war_declared.text: {enemy_faction} wants war with {my_faction}? Fine! We will bring the goose, the chicken, and far too much mud :D
War on {enemy_faction}! Declared with a trumpet, a tavern song and a very dramatic cape flourish xD
{my_faction} is now at war with {enemy_faction}. Pack snacks, sharpen spoons, and blame the bridge :)
Declaring war on {enemy_faction} in the name of my sacred chicken. Do not ask why. Just grab a shield :D

encounter_greeting.text: Halt, {player}! I, {persona} of {my_faction}, Duke of Empty Cups, demand you surrender your snacks :D
Oh, {player}! It is {persona} of {my_faction}. Lovely weather for a fight, don't you think? Or a picnic xD
{player}, my dear friend! {persona} here, still wearing that cup on my head. Shall we raid something together? :)
Ah, {player}. I have named a puddle after you. It is a very nice puddle. Your army is about to meet it :/
{player}, is that your banner or a bedsheet? Either way, {persona} of {my_faction} salutes you, sort of :D

whisper_taunt.text: I hear {rival} beat you at the ford, {player}. Consider this your official fan club invitation. Membership is mud. :D
{player}, your banners look like they were sewn by a sleepy goose. I say this with love, and sarcasm xD
{rival} has been asking about you, {player}. Don't worry, I told them you are still growing into your sword :)
Quick question, {player}: do you also get lost on the bridge? Asking for my bridge, which is currently my enemy :/
{player}, I wrote a song about your last retreat. The chorus is just 'run, run, run'. Catchy, right? :D
